name: Endovia Health Sciences Inc.
summary: Endovia Health Sciences is a diversified cannabinoid-based health sciences platform. The company's strategy focuses on three main areas: commercializing differentiated cannabinoid-based pharmaceutical products internationally, advancing cannabinoid-based human and veterinary therapeutics through U.S. regulatory pathways, and developing consumer wellness and beverage products. This marks a strategic transformation from its prior operations as a beverage company.
